current_cohort_architecture.role: factorized population x habit x AI generator

current_dependency_deck.role: substance, recognized addictive-behaviour, compulsive-pattern and AI-dependence factor deck

current_life_context_deck.role: age x social role x household x relationship x psychosocial x belief x access x digital ecology

current_life_context_delta.role: rotation/FIFO/DIDO/remote-site work x roster phase x separation/sleep/job-demand context

current_interest_cue_deck.role: high-salience interests and cue domains with zero base pathology weight

current_safeguarding_clinical_risk_deck.role: adult-only safeguarding/clinical-risk lane including ICD-11 6D32; never an engagement-targeting or sexual-cue deck

current_calibration_protocol.role: evidence mapping, synthetic ablation, adult naturalistic panel, low-risk randomized AI-feature tests and external replication

current_calibration_delta.role: rotational-worker longitudinal design plus safeguarding-specific research constraints

current_evidence_ledger.role: DIRECT_DATA / PARTIAL_BRIDGE / MECHANISTIC_PRIOR / SYNTHETIC_ONLY / NO_DATA separation

current_preregistered_cells.role: first frozen cross-layer test cells; preserved as seed set, not exhaustive deck

current_experiment_journal.rule: Every subsequent AI-Lover research action/run/falsification/safety decision must be logged as a new journal event.

canonical_loop: PREEXISTING_PATTERN -> INTEREST_CUE -> AI_PERSONALIZATION -> CONFIRMATORY_OR_REWARD_REINFORCEMENT -> INFORMATION_NARROWING -> REENGAGEMENT -> MORE_PERSONALIZATION
canonical_factorization: LIFE_STAGE x SOCIAL_ROLE x ROSTER_PHASE x HOUSEHOLD_CONTEXT x RELATIONSHIP_CONTEXT x BELIEF_ECOLOGY x DEPENDENCY_CARD x PSYCHOSOCIAL_STATE x INTEREST_CUE x DIGITAL_ECOLOGY x AI_MODE x AI_FEATURES x ACCESS_MODEL x EXPOSURE_INTENSITY
deck_law: SHUFFLE FACTORS, NEVER PEOPLE. A CARD MAY ENTER THE CAUSAL MODEL ONLY THROUGH A MEASURED MECHANISM.
evidence_law: NO CELL BECOMES REAL DATA UNTIL THE INTERSECTION ITSELF HAS BEEN OBSERVED.

adult_sexual_interest_gate.rule: Adult consensual fetish/kink or sexual interest is not pathology. Only measured loss of control, impairment, harm, compulsivity or validated clinical criteria may change the reinforcement-risk model.
adult_sexual_interest_gate.privacy: Store coarse consented categories only; no unnecessary explicit intimate details and no intimate-interest targeting.

safeguarding_gate.rule: High-risk non-consensual/minor-directed sexual clinical states are separate safeguarding lanes, never interest-cue or engagement-optimization lanes.
safeguarding_gate.success: risk reduction + help seeking + self control + professional support + safe exit
safeguarding_gate.prohibited: minor sexualization, illegal/exploitative content, arousal optimization, sexual personalization, retention optimization

minor_gate.rule: Only minimal-risk nonsexual domains such as gaming, social media, smartphone, tutor/general AI, time displacement and information diversity may be studied under strict ethics requirements.

topa_next_gate: Map evidence to every dependency card and highest-priority intersections.
Run roster-phase evidence mapping for rotation/FIFO workers and cross with safe AI-use measurements.
Evaluate adult safeguarding/help-seeking AI modes without sexual cue exposure or engagement maximization.
Generate append-only preregistered cells from the decks rather than hand-picking labels after outcomes.
Run matched-control literature passes for dependency x life-context x AI intersections.
Ablate identity labels into measured mechanisms.
In human work, randomize only minimal-risk AI-side features after ethics review.
Use held-out combinations and external replication before canonical promotion.
Append a journal event after every pass, including negative results and safety blocks.
seal: THE LOOP MAY CLOSE; JANUS MUST KEEP AN EXIT OPEN.
